item.title: Meme Weapons v1.1
item.creator: Carper Creative
item.description:
Hilarious chaos with 15 unique weapons! Each features custom abilities, sounds, and animations for entertaining combat. From ground-slamming Bonk Hammer to slippery Soap of Justice - memorable moments guaranteed.

+ 15 weapons with special abilities
+ Custom sounds and particle effects
+ Interactive guidebook

faqEntries.heading: How do I get the Guidebook?
faqEntries.content: The Guidebook is automatically given to a player on their first spawn. If it is missing, craft it at a crafting table using 1 wooden sword and 3 books.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use the weapons on players?
faqEntries.content: Yes. For weapons that require a target, aim at a player or mob. Prank Players must be enabled for both you and the other player.

faqEntries.heading: Is my progress saved?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Meme Collection, Meme Challenges, and Settings are saved separately for each player.

faqEntries.heading: How do I know when I can use a weapon again?
faqEntries.content: When Cooldown Meter is enabled, an on-screen message shows the remaining cooldown time.

faqEntries.heading: Can the effects damage blocks?
faqEntries.content: Break Blocks is disabled by default. Enable it in Settings if you want supported effects to change blocks.

faqEntries.heading: How much content does the Add-On include?
faqEntries.content: The collection contains 15 meme weapons, and Meme Challenges include 9 challenges across three tiers.

howToEntries.heading: Start with the Guidebook
howToEntries.content: You receive the Guidebook when you first spawn. If you do not have it, craft it at a crafting table using 1 wooden sword and 3 books.

howToEntries.heading: Craft the first weapons
howToEntries.content: Open the Guidebook and select Starter Weapons to see the first recipes: Bonk Hammer, Toilet Paper Wand, Sleepinator 3000, and Keyboard Sword. All weapons are crafted at a crafting table.

howToEntries.heading: Complete your collection
howToEntries.content: Successfully use each of the 15 weapons at least once. Open Meme Collection to see discovered and undiscovered weapons; progress is saved for each player.

howToEntries.heading: Aim and use
howToEntries.content: For weapons that require a target, aim at a mob or player and use the item. Cooldown Meter shows when the weapon can be used again.

howToEntries.heading: Master the challenges
howToEntries.content: Open Meme Challenges to track 9 challenges across three tiers. Some challenges require hitting the same target with another weapon within 6 or 10 seconds.

howToEntries.heading: Customize your experience
howToEntries.content: In Settings, toggle Effect Chat, Break Blocks, Prank Players, Cooldown Meter, and Screen Shake. Your choices are saved for each player.
